note: CKEditor CodeMirror ships exactly one CKEditor 5 plugin, ckeditor_codemirror_source_editing, plus a CKEditor4To5Upgrade plugin. It has no settings page (no `configure` key), no permissions, no Drush commands, no services and defines no plugin types. All of its persistent state is per text format inside editor.editor.<format> -> settings.plugins.ckeditor_codemirror_source_editing (keys: enable, mode, options{autoCloseBrackets,autoCloseTags,folding,lineNumbers,lineWrapping,matchBrackets,matchTags,searchBottom,styleActiveLine}). The plugin declares conditions {plugins: {ckeditor5_sourceEditing}}, so the format's settings.toolbar.items must contain 'sourceEditing'. Medium cases read that config back off the live site; hard cases require writing it (one of them also requires adding the Source button first). Every eval artifact is namespaced with the ckeditor_codemirror_ prefix so it cannot collide with other modules' formats.

evals.prompt: I installed the Drupal contrib module ckeditor_codemirror on a Drupal 11 site but I cannot find an admin settings page for it. Where do I turn CodeMirror syntax highlighting on, and in which configuration object is that choice stored?
evals.expected_output: The module has no global settings form. You configure it per text format at Configuration > Content authoring > Text formats and editors (/admin/config/content/formats): configure a CKEditor 5 format and open the 'CodeMirror source editing' vertical tab under CKEditor 5 plugin settings. The values are stored in the editor.editor.<format> config entity under settings.plugins.ckeditor_codemirror_source_editing (enable, mode, options).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the ckeditor_codemirror module enabled, the 'CodeMirror source editing' settings tab does not appear when I configure one of my CKEditor 5 text formats. What is the prerequisite that makes that tab (and the plugin itself) show up?
evals.expected_output: The plugin definition declares conditions = {plugins: {ckeditor5_sourceEditing}}, so core's Source editing plugin must be active on that format - i.e. the 'Source' button must be dragged into the active toolbar (settings.toolbar.items must contain 'sourceEditing'). Without it the vertical tab is hidden and the CodeMirror library is never attached.

evals.prompt: Which external JavaScript libraries does the Drupal ckeditor_codemirror module require, where in the Drupal installation must they be placed, and is CodeMirror 6 acceptable?
evals.expected_output: It needs CodeMirror version 5 (v6 is NOT supported) at /libraries/codemirror and the @cdubz/ckeditor5-source-editing-codemirror bridge at /libraries/ckeditor5-source-editing-codemirror, both under the docroot libraries directory. hook_requirements() reports both on /admin/reports/status; the module ships a composer.libraries.json for use with the Composer Merge plugin.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a text format whose machine name is ckeditor_codemirror_eval and which uses CKEditor 5 with CodeMirror source highlighting turned on. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which CodeMirror syntax highlighting mode value is configured for that format.
evals.expected_output: The mode is text/x-scss (the 'SCSS' option): editor.editor.ckeditor_codemirror_eval -> settings.plugins.ckeditor_codemirror_source_editing.mode = text/x-scss, with enable: true.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has two CKEditor 5 text formats, ckeditor_codemirror_on and ckeditor_codemirror_off. Both carry ckeditor_codemirror settings, but only one of them actually has CodeMirror source highlighting switched on. Inspect the running site and tell me which format has it enabled.
evals.expected_output: ckeditor_codemirror_on has it enabled: editor.editor.ckeditor_codemirror_on -> settings.plugins.ckeditor_codemirror_source_editing.enable is true, while the same key on editor.editor.ckeditor_codemirror_off is false.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a CKEditor 5 text format with the machine name ckeditor_codemirror_task; its toolbar already contains the Source button. Using the ckeditor_codemirror module, enable CodeMirror source-view syntax highlighting on that format, set its highlighting mode to SCSS, and make sure line numbers are shown. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: editor.editor.ckeditor_codemirror_task -> settings.plugins.ckeditor_codemirror_source_editing must have enable: true, mode: text/x-scss and options.lineNumbers: true (the other eight option keys should also be present as booleans).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the CKEditor 5 text format ckeditor_codemirror_nosrc currently has only Bold and Italic in its toolbar. Make CodeMirror source highlighting work on that format: do whatever the ckeditor_codemirror plugin requires so it can be activated, then turn it on with the PHP (including HTML) highlighting mode and code folding enabled. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: editor.editor.ckeditor_codemirror_nosrc -> settings.toolbar.items must contain 'sourceEditing' (the plugin's condition), and settings.plugins.ckeditor_codemirror_source_editing must have enable: true, mode: application/x-httpd-php and options.folding: true.
